serialize_atoms_to_json: serialize an ase.Atoms instance to a JSON string using serialize_atoms
deserialize_atoms_from_json: deserialize a JSON string back to an ase.Atoms instance using deserialize_atoms
convert_pymatgen_to_atoms: convert a pymatgen Structure object to an ase.Atoms object using convert_to_atoms
encode_numpy_arrays: encode numpy arrays and complex types to JSON using the ASEEncoder class
